Maya (AE): Quick heads-up 90-minute POC ask from DataGate. They want EU-only for processing and an explicit list of subprocessors + a sample pinned-routing config to give their auditors. Can we deliver?
Hugo (SE): Yes. Hosted endpoints support regional pins. For a short POC we can apply a per-tenant routing rule: pin to eu-west1 + eu-central1 and set fallback = none so requests fail when capacity isn't available.
Maya (AE): Theyxpect ~15-25 r/s, avg 120 tokens. No BYOK for POC.
Carla (Legal): I'll produce the subproc CSV but we need to call out control-plane telemetry location and be explicit about what does/doesn't leave the EU.
Priya (SRE): Tech note: data plane (payloads & model execution) can be constrained to pinned EU regions. Small routing health pings and anonymized metrics currently flow to our control plane (us-central) by default. We can state that as "operational telemetry only".
Hugo (SE): Minimal example config we can hand them:
```
routing_policy:
  type: geo_pin
  regions: [eu-west1, eu-central1]
  fallback: none   # fail-closed -> 429/503 when no capacity
  telemetry_scope: minimal
```
Hugo (SE): Also include a curl example for their tests: `curl -X POST https://eu-west1.api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H \"Authorization: Bearer <POC_KEY>\" -d '{\"input\":\"test\"}'`
Maya (AE): They also want confirmation whether audit logs and request metadata can be stored in EU-only buckets.
Priya (SRE): Yes 90we can configure audit/log storage to an EU-only bucket for the POC. Option: "no payload retention" flag for the trial.
Carla (Legal): Draft paragraph I'll include: "Inference requests and model execution will occur only in pinned EU regions. Control-plane operational telemetry (routing health, anonymized metrics and request hashes) may be processed by our control plane in the US; no full request payloads or customer PII will be transmitted outside the EU for this POC."
Maya (AE): Deadline: customer needs subproc CSV + config + one-line cost uplift estimate by EOD tomorrow for procurement. Can we make it?
Priya (SRE): I can produce the network-path note + cost uplift (estimate ~12% for pinned routing) and open a routing change ticket.
Carla (Legal): I'll upload the subproc list and the SOW blurb referencing fail-closed acceptance.
ops-bot: Ticket PRESALES-11872 created. Owner: Priya (SRE). ETA: 48h.
Maya (AE): Great 93 I'll package runbook + subproc list + cost note and send to DataGate. Will update when SOW signed. :white_check_mark:
